jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst

Location: Remote

Duration: Contract-to-Hire

Job Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to support its Data Analytics Center of Excellence. The role focuses on developing data analytics solutions, predictive models, dashboards, and reports to generate actionable business insights and support strategic decision-making across membership, sales, investments, and charitable operations.
Key Responsibilities

Develop and enhance predictive analytics, statistical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex business data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Identify, integrate, and enrich internal and external data sources.
Develop visualizations and reports using relevant analytics tools.
Partner with IT, Data Warehouse, IT Security, and business teams on data initiatives.
Communicate analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data analytics awareness, training, and best practices across the organization.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in data analysis, predictive modeling, or statistical analysis.
Strong SQL programming skills.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, and/or ArcGIS.
Experience with Python and/or R for predictive and statistical modeling.
Knowledge of data modeling, data engineering, data visualization, databases, and data warehouses.
Experience with CRM, ERP, cloud-based applications, and data lake architectures.
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced Excel, Access, VBA, and PowerPoint skills.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business, Statistics, Analytics, Marketing, or a related field.
Master's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

Key Focus:
Candidates should have strong SQL, Snowflake, data visualization, and predictive/statistical modeling experience using Python or R, with the ability to translate business data into actionable insights.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting
